article_title: Genomewide Analysis and Biological Characterization of Cathelicidins with Potent Antimicrobial Activity and Low Cytotoxicity from Three Bat Species
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-review closed the prior targeted ticket after source-reviewed worker-2 Table 3/Table 4 repair and worker-4 database adjudication. The paper is publication-grade with preserved cautions, not accepted_clean.
summary: Source-reviewed rework resolved the activity-table and database-adjudication blockers for this paper while preserving nonblocking APD6 literature-only, nested-supplement inventory, Figure 1 precision, PD-CATH cytotoxicity, and mechanism-scope cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material remains a structural source inventory; nested supplement undercount is preserved as nonblocking caution after read-only inspection of the OA package zip.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required final JSON artifacts are present and parseable; this is separate from source-reviewed publication grade.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 verified the six DBAASP peptide records and three full-length APD6 cross-records against Table 1, preserved APD6 literature-only rows as database_only_no_primary_source, and did not flatten later-literature/database-only caveats.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired Table 3 yeast MIC rows and Table 4 HaCaT viability rows, rebuilt Table 2 peptide MIC rows with correct peptide/entity fields, and recorded Figure 1 Mucor outcomes only at supported precision.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is phenotype-supported/inferred only; no direct molecular mechanism assay is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_publication_grade: No blocking or major issue remains after this bounded source review; prior ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is resolved with cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: 37 APD6 literature-only rows remain database_only_no_primary_source rather than being promoted to primary-source experimental records.

The packet extraction report counts zero supplementary assets, but the OA package contains a nested supplementary zip; read-only inspection found sequence/genome-analysis supplement tables and a supplement figure, not additional activity/toxicity rows.
Mucor records preserve only source-supported approximate/no-inhibition outcomes; exact figure bar heights were not fabricated.
PD-CATH remains noncytotoxic at 64 μg/mL but shows severe HaCaT viability loss at 160 μg/mL; final summary keeps this dose-dependent caution.
Primary paper supports antimicrobial/toxicity phenotypes but no direct molecular mechanism assay.
